learner_notice: Commit one response before feedback appears. Entry checks are low stakes; a missed fresh re-entry returns control without exit credit.

items.title: Prerequisite check: quantitative and graph skills
items.prompt: Before nuclear content, evaluate two prerequisite statements. Q: (8.0 × 10^2)/(2.0 × 10^1) = 4.0 × 10^1. G: on a plot with log(remaining amount) on the vertical axis and time on the horizontal axis, repeated halving over equal time intervals gives equal vertical drops. Which evaluation is correct?
options: Q and G are both correct
Q is correct; G is incorrect
Q is incorrect; G is correct
Q and G are both incorrect
items.directions: Choose one response, then commit it to receive feedback.

items.title: Prerequisite recheck: semilog slope
items.prompt: After returning from quantitative prerequisite work, use a fresh graph check before nuclear content. A straight line on a plot of log10(remaining amount) versus time passes through (0 h, 2.0) and (6 h, 1.4). What is the slope of the line?
items.directions: Choose one response, then commit it to receive feedback.
